NeorGoogleKeywords.ApiLimitNotice: The API limit of 50,000 rows was reached on one of the days. Detailed data may be incomplete.
NeorGoogleKeywords.ChartAxesHelp: Clicks use the left axis and impressions the right. The scales are independent: compare trends and hover for exact values.

NeorGoogleKeywords.ChartGapsHelp: Line gaps indicate days without imports. A zero point is an imported day with no clicks or impressions. The latest two days are usually not yet available for import.

NeorGoogleKeywords.CustomStylesSuffix: — custom styles loaded after the base styles.

NeorGoogleKeywords.DaySavedCapped: Day saved: %s. The API detail limit was reached.

NeorGoogleKeywords.PartialImport: Some days have not been imported; totals cover saved days only.
NeorGoogleKeywords.PluginDescription: Daily Google Search Console import and standalone search query reports. Service account authentication.
NeorGoogleKeywords.PropertyAccessHelp: The service account must be added as a user of this exact property. URL-prefix and domain properties are separate entries.
NeorGoogleKeywords.QueryReportHelp: Queries are not linked to Matomo visitors. CTR is calculated from total clicks and impressions; position is weighted by impressions. Sorting covers all report pages.

Period dates are shown above each table; only imported days are counted. Google hides some queries, so phrase totals may differ from property totals.
NeorGoogleKeywords.SaveDayFailed: Could not save the imported day. Previous data has been retained; check the database and free disk space.
NeorGoogleKeywords.SavedDaysHelp: Totals cover saved days; missing days are excluded.
NeorGoogleKeywords.ScheduleHelp: Once a day through the Matomo scheduler; check the log to confirm cron is running.

NeorGoogleKeywords.ServiceAccountKeyRequired: A Google service account JSON key is required.
